name: Elemental Healing Spell-like Ability (Monster)
body:
You can use an elemental spell-like ability to cure living beings, or a cure spell-like ability to damage evil creatures.

Prerequisites: Spell-like ability at caster level 6th or higher.

Benefit: Choose one of your spell-like abilities that either is a cure effect or inflicts acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, subject to the restrictions described in this feat. Three times per day, you may empower that spell-like ability so that it cures good creatures and deals energy damage to evil creatures for the same amount listed in its description. If you possess an elemental subtype, you must select the energy type matching your subtype. A spell-like ability modified this way has no effect on neutral creatures.

The damage inflicted to evil creatures has the same descriptor of the original spell in case of an elemental spell, or an elemental descriptor matching the selected energy type in case of a healing spell-like ability; the modified spell-like ability gains both the healing descriptor and the appropriate energy descriptor.

You can only select a spell-like ability duplicating a spell with a level less than or equal to ½ your caster level (round down) –1. For a summary, see the following table.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time it is taken, you can apply it to a different spell-like ability.

Spell Level	Caster Level
0	2nd
1st	4th
2nd	6th
3rd	8th
4th	10th
5th	12th
6th	14th
7th	16th
8th	18th
9th	20th
